solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Garment that is worn out

parts.note: a garment worn outside, over everything else, rather than one that is shabby from use

explanation.surface: A piece of clothing that has seen better days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Worn out' suggests threadbare, but here it means worn out of doors, on top of other clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a heavy outer garment put on over other clothes in cold weather.

clue.text: Some Central European capitalists

parts.note: people living in a Central European capital city, not investors

explanation.surface: A group of money-minded businessmen from Central Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capitalists' looks like financiers; read it as people from a capital, here Austria's.
explanation.definitionFit: The inhabitants of Vienna, the capital of Austria, are literally residents of a capital.

clue.text: Withdrawal of old type of engine

parts.note: re means 'concerning' or 'of', as in a letter heading
a traction engine is a steam-powered road locomotive of former times

explanation.surface: An early engine design being taken out of service.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking back a statement or claim is a withdrawal of it.

clue.text: Personal aspiration that is a mistake

parts.note: something personal is one's own
an aspiration is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: Someone's private ambition turns out to be an error.
explanation.walkthrough: In football an own goal is scored into one's own net; figuratively it is any self-inflicted blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: an action that backfires on its doer is a self-inflicted mistake.

clue.text: Soldiers coming from Oporto heading off

indicators.note: the soldiers are made out of the remaining letters, rearranged
the leading letter of the city's name is removed

explanation.surface: Troops arriving from the Portuguese city of Oporto have set off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' drops the first O of Oporto, leaving PORTO; 'coming from' rearranges PORTO into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A troop is a unit of soldiers, and the plural noun means soldiers collectively.

clue.text: Question leads to one lucky break, pronto

indicators.note: the letters of these words are broken up and re-formed

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A query prompts a stroke of good fortune, and fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Pronto is an informal word for at once, without delay.

clue.text: Small ship's restricting to composer

indicators.note: the ship's name surrounds and so confines the other word

parts.note: a bark or barque is a sailing ship

explanation.surface: A little vessel is being confined to a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: Béla Bartók was a Hungarian composer of the twentieth century.

clue.text: Resent having to ask Barnaby

parts.note: to beg is to ask earnestly
Barnaby Rudge is the title character of a Dickens novel

explanation.surface: Someone resents being made to plead with a man called Barnaby.
explanation.definitionFit: To feel grudging envy or ill will over something is to resent it.

clue.text: Refuse to give hard time

parts.note: rough means harsh or hard, as in a rough time
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone declines to give anyone a difficult time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' reads as the verb; it is the noun, coarse leftover material.
explanation.definitionFit: Chambers lists coarse leftover material from crops among its senses, the fibrous waste of plants.

clue.text: Ten entering to attack church officer

indicators.note: one piece goes into the middle of the other

parts.note: to set on someone is to attack them
X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: Ten men burst in to assault a church official.
explanation.definitionFit: A sexton is a church officer who looks after the building and graveyard.

clue.text: See closure get complicated

indicators.note: the letters of these words are tangled into a new order

explanation.surface: Watch how the ending turns intricate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like a verb but is the noun: a bishop's diocese.
explanation.definitionFit: Gloucester is a cathedral city and the seat of a bishop, so a see.

clue.text: Black stuff out of the blue?

definitions.text: Black stuff out of the blue?

parts.words: Black stuff out of the blue?
parts.note: black fuel coming from the sea, the blue, rather than appearing unexpectedly

explanation.surface: Something dark arriving unexpectedly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out of the blue' means unexpectedly, but the blue is the sea, and black stuff is coal.
explanation.definitionFit: Lumps of coal washed up on the shore from the sea were gathered as fuel under this name.

clue.text: Cow being not as fast, doesn't start

parts.note: slower means less fast

explanation.surface: A cow that is slower than the rest is lagging behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cow' is a whimsical definition: a cow lows, so it is a 'lower'.
explanation.definitionFit: Cows low, or moo, so playfully a cow is something that lows.

clue.text: Way photographer was successful?

parts.note: the camera shutter ..., and an idea that ... was a success

explanation.surface: How a photographer achieved success.
explanation.walkthrough: Clicked means worked out or succeeded, and is also what a camera does.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, something that clicked went well, and a camera clicks when a picture is taken.

clue.text: Large number ruin fashion

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
to raze is to destroy completely

explanation.surface: A great many people wreck a trend.
explanation.definitionFit: A craze is a short-lived fashion or fad.

clue.text: Order a set of books for officer

parts.note: a command is an order
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: Ordering a series of volumes for an army officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A commandant is the officer in charge of a military establishment.

clue.text: Look right by railway truck

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look

explanation.surface: Look to the right by a railway truck.
explanation.definitionFit: A lorry is the British word for a truck.

clue.text: Manipulate engineer going to dance

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers, the British army corps
a jig is a lively dance

explanation.surface: Fiddling an engineer about as he heads off to dance.
explanation.definitionFit: To rejig is to rearrange or adjust something, so to manipulate it.

clue.text: Others find space where there are washing facilities

parts.note: the rest are the others
room means space

explanation.surface: The others find a spot with a place to wash.
explanation.definitionFit: A restroom is a toilet with washbasins in a public building, the American term.

clue.text: Wide beam revealed by clumsy Melissa — no sex appeal

indicators.note: the name's letters are handled awkwardly and come out in a new order
the letters standing for sex appeal are left out of the mix

explanation.surface: A broad grin shows on an awkward Melissa who lacks allure.
explanation.walkthrough: Take SA out of MELISSA, leaving MELIS, which 'clumsy' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A broad smile is often called a beam, so a wide beam is a big grin.

clue.text: Most recent appointment gets the call

parts.note: last means most recent
a post is a job or appointment

explanation.surface: The latest job comes with a summons.
explanation.walkthrough: The Last Post is the bugle call sounded at military funerals and at day's end.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a bugle call, so it is the call in the military sense.

clue.text: Reportedly eyes sudden grab

indicators.note: the word is as heard, not as written

parts.note: to eye is to see, so eyes is sees

explanation.surface: Someone spots a chance and snatches it.
explanation.definitionFit: To seize is to take hold of something suddenly and forcibly.

clue.text: Goes round by way of Spanish city

indicators.note: the letters are turned about into a new order

parts.note: via means by way of

explanation.surface: Someone travels about via a Spanish city.
explanation.definitionFit: Segovia is a historic city in central Spain known for its Roman aqueduct.

clue.text: Strong feeling when first volume turns up

indicators.note: in a down clue the pieces are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: No 1, number one, means first
a tome is a large volume

explanation.surface: A rush of emotion as the first book in a series arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns up' reverses NOI + TOME, giving the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An emotion is a strong feeling such as joy, anger or fear.

clue.text: Bridging tool?

parts.note: a workman's tool, and also something that spans a gap

explanation.surface: An implement for making bridges.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a tool for turning nuts, and something that spans is a bridge.

clue.text: A bit each

parts.note: a piece is a bit

explanation.surface: A small amount for everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Apiece means for each one, as in a pound apiece.

clue.text: BEMs, say, distributed in diplomat's office

indicators.note: the letters are spread around into a new order

explanation.surface: Medals such as the BEM are handed out at an ambassador's base.
explanation.walkthrough: BEM is the British Empire Medal, an honour Britain awards.
explanation.definitionFit: An embassy is the official residence and office of an ambassador.

clue.text: Last character had performing bear or another animal

parts.note: Z is the last letter of the alphabet

indicators.note: the animal's letters are made to perform, rearranging them

explanation.surface: The final act featured a performing bear or some other creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'performing' is the anagram signal: the bear performs by changing its letters, which follow the last letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: A zebra is a striped African animal, another beast besides the bear.

clue.text: A frontier's been moved in wooded area

indicators.note: the letters are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A border has been shifted through a forested region.
explanation.definitionFit: A rainforest is a dense tropical forest, so a wooded area.

clue.text: Arguing whilst forming line

definitions.meaning: standing one behind another, in a line

explanation.surface: Bickering while queuing.
explanation.definitionFit: A row is a quarrel and also a line, so the phrase means either.

clue.text: Tenant that may come after owner where rent's not paid

definitions.text: Tenant that may come after owner where rent's not paid

parts.words: Tenant that may come after owner where rent's not paid
parts.note: a holder of property, and the word that follows 'owner' to name someone who lives in a home they own

explanation.surface: A tenant who succeeds the landlord where no rent is owed.
explanation.walkthrough: An owner-occupier owns the home they live in, so pays no rent; Chambers allows 'tenant' as anyone holding property.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone living in and holding a property is its tenant in the broad sense.

clue.text: Not a neat development to comment on

indicators.note: the letters develop into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An untidy development needs remarking upon.
explanation.definitionFit: To annotate is to add explanatory notes, so to comment on a text.
